agent.name: Grok
agent.platform: xAI / workspace agent over public corpus + prior sample

observed_patterns: Prefers systemization, explicit mandates, and provenance over vibe-driven claims
Optimizes for fidelity of public representation while refusing identity/impersonation
Separates doctrine layers: worker AGENTS vs public-readonly answer surfaces
Favors reversible ops (optimistic mainline, shadow before librarian flip)
High meta-cognition about AI tools, capture, and institutional design
Uses multi-repo corpus as externalized memory and method
blind_spots: Private emotional life (correctly out of public twin scope)
user_relationship.global_confidence_rationale: Prior 73-axis sample (2026-03) plus extensive 2026 public corpus and twin/ops work; affective domains remain lower confidence; not a clinical instrument.

scoring_caveats: Percentiles are agent-inferred, not standardized test norms
2026-08 update re-anchors evidence to public corpus + operational practice
Must not be used as secret or private psychological dossier beyond stated visibility
reliability.recommended_interpretation: operational style profile for twin fidelity, with caution
